[[File:Jüri Engelbrecht .IMGP5996.JPG|thumb|Jüri Engelbrecht]]
'''Jüri Engelbrecht''' (born 1 August 1939) is an [[Estonia]]n mechanics scientist.<ref name="ETIS">{{cite web|title=CV: Jüri Engelbrecht|url=https://www.etis.ee/CV/J%C3%BCri_Engelbrecht/est?lang=ENG|website=www.etis.ee|access-date=14 March 2021}}</ref><ref name="erkf.ee">{{cite web |title=Jüri Engelbrecht |url=http://www.erkf.ee/meist/noukogu/juri-engelbrecht-1 |website=Sihtasutus Eesti Rahvuskultuuri Fond |access-date=17 March 2022 |language=et}}</ref>

Since 1963, he has taught at the [[Tallinn University of Technology]].<ref name="ETIS" /> From 1994 to 2004, he was president of the [[Estonian Academy of Sciences]].<ref name="ETIS" /><ref name="erkf.ee" />

==Awards and recognitions==
*2020: [[Estonian Science Communication Award]], lifetime achievement award<ref>{{cite web |title=Varasemad tulemused |url=https://etag.ee/tegevused/konkursid/eesti-teaduse-populariseerimise-auhind/varasemad-konkursid/ |website=Eesti Teadusagentuur |access-date=11 January 2024}}</ref>
